findings.summary: The one-line addition of "enclosing_structure_statements" to _OWNERS_BY_MODULE sits outside the node's declared write paths, so the landed change is not inside the exclusive fence it was dispatched with. It is also unused: the only definition and the only call are in worker_review_names.py (:76 and :238) and no module passes the string to _worker_dependency, so neither tests/standard_names/test_worker_dependency_table.py nor any runtime path resolves that name. Repair is to delete the line, which also brings the diff back inside the fence.

_ENCLOSING_STRUCTURE_QUERY duplicates a capability the repository already owns: imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:498 _ANCESTOR_CONTEXT_QUERY walks the same (n:IMASNode)-[:HAS_PARENT*1..]->(a:IMASNode) chain for the ancestor's description/documentation and returns depth and path ordered nearest-first. The addition is a second Cypher with a batch id list and depth 4 instead of extending or wrapping the owner, so the depth limit, the documentation-else-description precedence and the whitespace collapse now have two homes that can drift.

Both source-support checks are overwritten with answered=true, failed=false, decision=accept and noul 0.0 whenever the resolver fires, so for the settled class the judge's answer is discarded rather than corrected, and the class measure 'no name answers above cutoff' is true partly by construction. The trigger is a stem match of every qualifier word anywhere in any enclosing structure's text (states_token at :676), with no negation or proximity handling, so a structure saying 'not in equivalent electrons', or naming the words while describing another quantity, settles the check as supported. The recorded source_support keeps the statement, so the value can be re-read, but nothing narrows the match.

after_suite records revision 702645387, not the landed head fa84422c3: three commits landed after the arm, one of them eb9fb78af which changes product source (:275 in worker_tasks/__init__.py). The whole-directory clause of the done_when therefore has no receipt covering the tree it landed in. A re-run of the same command at fa84422c3 would close it; the two arms differ only by that one table line, which no test asserts.

The sample states 199 accepted names where the done_when fixes the sample at two hundred. The skip is recorded in the source manifest (one name dropped on the same stale DD resolution that left five class members unmeasurable), so the deviation is explained, but the number measured is not the number the measure proposes, and nothing states why 199 closes a two-hundred name sample.

The 43 lines that decide what the review is told have no test: enclosing_structure_statements' query, its documentation-else-description precedence, its whitespace collapse, its empty-statement skip and its per-leaf dedupe are unexercised by tests/standard_names/test_name_review_source_context.py, which supplies dd_source_docs items directly. The only evidence the graph side works is the one-off class pass, which is not a regression guard, and eb9fb78af is a fix in exactly this area whose defect no assertion would catch if it returned.
